description: Fast, cheap search across Wikipedia, Hacker News, DuckDuckGo and Stack Overflow. ★ One of our best tools. Web search API for AI agents, lowest-cost tier: Wikipedia articles, Hacker News stories, DuckDuckGo instant answers and Stack Overflow questions (quota permitting) in one call, merged, de-duplicated and ranked, with titles, links, snippets and dates. Good for facts and for tech news and discussion (Hacker News). q is the search words; limit caps results; detail=brief trims fields. Use for quick facts, tech and programming lookups where results up to an hour old are fine. Instead, use `search-answer` ($0.015) for a written answer with citations. Answers may be cached for up to 1 hour. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. In the free trial.
name: search-open
